title: Smooth spectral statistics of random perturbations of Schrödinger operators near Anosov energy levels
summary: We investigate the spectral statistics of random perturbations of semiclassical Schrödinger operators on compact manifolds, near energy levels corresponding to chaotic classical dynamics. The prototypical example is that of an operator $h^2Δ+V(x)$ that is perturbed by a smooth potential $h^αV_ω$ with $α\in (0,1)$, and $V_ω$ is a random potential that decorrelates on distances $h^β$, with $0<β<2α$.
